Hon'ble Supreme Court, has pronounced an order on August 14, 2023 (received by us on August 16, 2023), in relation to the matter of levy of Service Tax amounting Rs. 86.42 Crore against the order passed by the Service Tax Department, wherein demand amounting Rs. 51.24 Crore (out of total amount of Rs. 86.42 Crore ) has been set aside by the Supreme Court on the ground that classification mentioned in the show cause notice viz.” management, maintenance and repair services” is erroneous and the rest of the matter has been remanded back to the adjudicating authority for reconsideration of the matter. Pursuant to the directions of the Hon’ble Supreme Court, the case was taken up for denovo adjudication. The Principal Commissioner, CGST & CX, Belapur, has since passed a partially favourable order reducing the net service tax demand to Rs.5.59 crores, along with applicable interest and penalties under Sections 73(2), 75, and 76 of the Finance Act, 1944.
